subject.title: fix(deepinfra): remove deprecated embedding provider warning

question: Should DeepInfra retain its current automatic-selection priority, explicit-auto behavior, and missing-key continuation when moving to the generic embedding-provider contract?
rationale: The patch removes three behavior-bearing legacy fields without showing an equivalent generic contract path; deciding whether to preserve or intentionally retire that compatibility behavior requires maintainer ownership of the embedding-provider migration.

options.title: Preserve selection behavior
options.body: Add the supported generic equivalent of the prior DeepInfra selection policy and test auto selection plus missing-key continuation before merging.

options.title: Intentionally retire auto selection
options.body: Document the changed DeepInfra selection behavior and accept the compatibility break only if maintainers explicitly want generic embeddings to stop honoring the legacy policy.

recommendation.title: Preserve selection behavior
recommendation.body: Add the supported generic equivalent of the prior DeepInfra selection policy and test auto selection plus missing-key continuation before merging.

likelyOwner.reason: The available context identifies this repository MEMBER as the active contributor for the DeepInfra migration, although current-main history ownership could not be independently established.
